name: Palova Horchata-Passionfruit
description: A small-batch sparkling soda blending real rice-based horchata base with passionfruit extract, lightly carbonated and finished with cinnamon dust. One of the few genuinely craft products in the Tier 3 market.
flavor_profile: Creamy rice sweetness with bright, tart passionfruit cutting through. Warm cinnamon on the back end. Silky carbonation, almost like a drinking dessert.
cultural_context: Palova Craft Beverages is one of the few remaining genuinely independent bottlers in GLMZ. It operates out of a converted warehouse in Tier 3's Lakeside district and has resisted multiple acquisition offers. Buying Palova is considered a mild act of anti-corporate sentiment, and the bottles are often kept and repurposed.
story_hooks: Palova's founder is dying and has no heir — three different corponations are quietly maneuvering to acquire the brand before the estate is settled, and the workers are trying to form a cooperative to stop them.
A counterfeit Palova operation is selling inferior product in Tier 2 using replicated bottles — it's undercutting the real brand and the fakes are nearly indistinguishable.
Palova's rice supply comes from an urban vertical farm that is quietly being threatened by a zoning seizure — the farm feeds more than just the bottler.
